items.description: Deals, discounts and offers worldwide, shown on a map.
Twups is a twitter aggregator, pulling the most popular twitter topics into one place, so you can keep up to date on what is going on in the world, via twitter.
MapDays allows users to refine event searching by location and time.

Psykotube is a great way to browse lots of videos really quickly. With Really simple and neat interface. This is great to get an overall vibe of a search and is at times faster than youtube's own search tool!
Using an integration of the Google Maps API and TRAFFY developed by NECTEC, this app shows realtime traffic information in Bangkok.

Get Twitter friend recommendations. Enter your Twitter username, this then crawls your existing friends, lets you see their friends, then find connections back to you as suggestions for who to follow.
The EVDB (now Eventful) API combined with MS MapPoint creates a mini-map (Feedmap) showing bloggers and events nearby a particular blogger.

Episkeptis helps users identify the best restaurants, bars, clubs and cafes in their city, with the help of their Facebook friends. Users are able to rate, recommend and share their favorites. Site is in Greek.
Lost your phone? Punch in your number and we'll call it for you.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.
Database of Google Earth placemarks. Find or share your favorite places on earth with others.
Barnard Marcus UK property and branch locator. Search for real estate to buy or rent.
Art Galleries, museums, and art fairs in Dallas, Texas.

Cordurl is part maps, part tinyurl, and part social network. Every spot on the globe is represented by a 7-digit geocode. You can subscribe to a geocode to meet your neighbors, find out what's happening in places where you spend time, and share info.
This mashup allows users to enter a US address and returns a map of the address point within the ZIP Code polygon.
